news.title: ‘Some people did everything right’: I lost my home in the Great Recession. I rent in my 50s. Why is that judged as failure?

news.desc_ko: "저는 연간 $ 110,000의 수입을 올리고 있습니다."

news.title: Walmart, Best Buy and other stores now use digital price tags. Critics say they could lead to different prices for different shoppers.

news.title: My spouse was awarded $90,000 from my 401(k) in our divorce. How is that fair?

news.title_ko: 제 배우자는 이혼으로 제 401 (k) 로부터 $ 90,000를 받았습니다. 그게 어떻게 공평한가요?
news.desc_ko: “저는 2020년에 은퇴했고 그 후 몇 년 후에 이혼했습니다.”
